title: GSE Joint Cyclic Gap Simplex single-exit closure requalification
purpose: Bind the corrected one-exit 360-degree closure contract and repeat the complete V2 zero-training readiness before any model is trained.

approval.scope: One immutable Gate-3 zero-training requalification after correcting the K=1 circular gap from zero to 360 degrees; no checkpoint, threshold, C09/C10/M-TARE/graph/planner.
approval.confirmation_reference: User requested continuous autonomous execution and delegated best-method choices without repeated approval prompts.

raw_sources: Sealed C01-C08 deduplicated five-frame causal LiDAR shards.
Sealed Joint Cyclic Gap Simplex V2 readiness.
source.license_or_allowed_use: Local project-generated procedural worlds and objective targets.

worlds.fit: No fit; all C01-C08 metadata and the fixed V2 real rows are audited.
worlds.forbidden: C09, C10 and all M-TARE worlds

sampling.rule: Repeat the V2 audit and explicitly prove that every K=1 target contributes one 360-degree closing gap, not zero.

teacher.source: Sealed continuous exit bearing, width and profile plus local axis and global geometry.
teacher.use: Sensor-azimuth ordered targets enter only cyclic-relabel invariant phase/gap/geometry losses; no identity.
teacher.valid_mask: Unchanged exact peak, width and global geometry masks.
teacher.student_input: Five causal normalized range/valid images only for eight real rows.

split.historical_pollution_audit: V2 is evidence only; no weights or model outputs are loaded.

methods.main: The V2 joint phase plus positive gap simplex with one corrected mathematical identity: a singleton set has one full 360-degree closing gap.
methods.baseline: V2 passed all eleven readiness checks but encoded the K=1 target closing gap as zero, creating a constant 360-degree localization error for singleton samples.
methods.fallback: If the singleton closure regression or any V2 population, symmetry, likelihood, gradient or real-backward check fails, stop before training.

acceptance.population: Exact 80 worlds, 188126 observations, 396913 exits and fixed eight real rows.
acceptance.singleton: K=1 target gap is exactly 360 degrees for arbitrary bearings.
acceptance.joint_set: All K=1..4 gaps are positive, close to 360 degrees and collapsed gaps receive corrective gradient.
acceptance.phase: Proper phase likelihood ordering and corrective gradient pass.
acceptance.symmetry: Authoritative V2 rotation/permutation checks remain within 3e-5.

failure_policy: Fail closed and preserve V2. Do not train unless the corrected code is independently frozen and requalified.
retention: Retain regression log, repeated readiness evidence, environment, RUN_STATE and seal.

estimated_cost.compute: CPU metadata audit plus eight-row forward/backward
